notes.title: Circuit City Patch #2
notes.content:
Circuit City v1.0.1.4 (Patch #2) has been released.  Steam should automatically update your game to the latest version.

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added autosave every two minutes
[*] Made code panel collapsible
[/list]

[h3]New Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] Restored CPU upgrade level 4 to the game
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issues offloading storage capacitors set to deconstruct
[*] Improved agent turn speed to get around tight corners
[/list]

notes.title: Circuit City Patch #1
notes.content:
Circuit City v1.0.1.3 (Patch #1) has been released.  Steam should automatically update your game to the latest version.

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Untrainer LED to deconvert trained agents back to haulers
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug in String Assembler that sometimes caused it to eat input it shouldn't, breaking the game state
[*] Fixed bug in final mission that caused it to sometimes be unwinnable
[*] Fixed bug that prevented endgame window from appearing
[/list]

notes.title: Circuit City Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1]Circuit City has officially been released![/h1]

 Circuit City is a laid-back city builder set on the micro-scale of a circuit board!  As your data agents do the bidding of algorithms provided by gigantic thumbdrives, they'll sing you a unique chiptune song!

[h2]Available Now:[/h2]
Circuit City base game

[h2]Coming Soon:[/h2]
Mod Support & Documentation
Additional in-game content

[h3]Love the game?  Want to get more involved?[/h3]
[url=https://discord.gg/gwtV2bWBas]Join our Discord Server[/url]!
[url=https://circuit-city.fandom.com/wiki/Circuit_City_Wiki]Contribute to the Wiki![/url]

[h3]Having trouble?[/h3]
As this is an indie release by a solo developer, some bugs are inevitable.  If you run into any trouble, try reaching out in the game's Steam Discussions forum, our Discord server, or email the support address on the store page.  Updates will be released rapidly to address reported issues.
